dish.title: Venezuelan Arepas with Black Beans, Sweet Plantains, and Avocado
dish.description: Golden, crusty corn arepas made from masarepa, seared on a griddle and finished in the oven until they puff, then split and stuffed with cumin-spiced black beans, oven-roasted sweet plantains, and avocado (a plant-based take on domino-style fillings).

recipe_version.title: Venezuelan Arepas with Black Beans, Sweet Plantains, and Avocado
recipe_version.description: Golden, crusty corn arepas made from masarepa, seared on a griddle and finished in the oven until they puff, then split and stuffed with cumin-spiced black beans, oven-roasted sweet plantains, and avocado (a plant-based take on domino-style fillings).

ingredients.name: masarepa
ingredients.display_name: precooked white corn meal (masarepa, e.g. P.A.N.)

ingredients.name: ripe plantains
ingredients.preparation: peeled, sliced 1/2 inch on the diagonal

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 1 tbsp dough, 2 tbsp beans, 1 tbsp plantains, 1 tbsp griddle

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 1/2 tsp dough, 3/4 tsp beans, 1/4 tsp plantains

steps.title: Preheat and prep
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 400 F to preheat, with racks in the upper and lower thirds, and line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment. Dice the onion and bell pepper, mince the garlic, drain and rinse the beans, and peel and slice the plantains.

steps.title: Cook the beans
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium. Cook the onion and bell pepper, stirring, until soft, 5 minutes. Add the garlic, cumin, and smoked paprika for 30 seconds, then the beans, 1/2 cup water, and 3/4 tsp salt. Simmer, stirring now and then, 10 minutes, mashing about half the beans so the mixture is thick and spoonable. Keep warm on low.

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.body: While the beans simmer, whisk 1 1/2 tsp salt into 2 1/2 cups warm water in a large bowl, add 1 tbsp oil, and gradually stir in the masarepa. Knead 2 minutes into a soft dough, then rest 5 minutes. Divide into 8 balls and press each into a 3-inch disc about 1/2 inch thick; smooth any cracked edges with a damp finger. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Roast the plantains
steps.body: When the beans are done (the oven has now preheated 20 minutes), toss the plantains with 1 tbsp oil and 1/4 tsp salt on one side of the lined pan and roast on the lower rack 25 to 27 minutes, flipping once, until deeply caramelized. Runs inside steps 5 and 6 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Sear the arepas
steps.body: Heat the cast-iron griddle over medium and brush with 1 tbsp oil. Sear the arepas in two batches, 3 minutes per side, until a pale-gold crust forms.

steps.title: Bake the arepas
steps.body: Move the arepas to the empty side of the sheet pan with the plantains and bake in the 400 F oven 15 minutes, until puffed and hollow-sounding when tapped. The plantains finish at the same time.

steps.title: Stuff and serve
steps.body: Let the arepas cool 1 minute, then split each one two-thirds of the way around with a serrated knife. Fill with beans, plantains, and avocado slices, tuck in cilantro, and serve with lime wedges.
